title: Single-cell genomic profiling of human dopamine neurons identifies a population that selectively degenerates in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: 10 DA neuron subtypes; AGTR1+ ventral-tier SOX6+ subtype most lost in PD; vulnerable subtype upregulates TP53/NR2F2 targets; PD heritability enriched in vulnerable DA subtype
notes: VERIFIED (PMC full text). Slide-seq performed on neurotypical SN only (spatial localisation of subtypes), so spatial data has no PD donors; snRNA part overlaps snRNA track

title: Characterization of altered molecular mechanisms in Parkinson's disease through cell type-resolved multiomics analyses
modality: snRNA-seq + snATAC-seq (separate assays, 10x v1 ATAC) + bulk H3K27ac ChIP + HiChIP/3D
n_ctrl: snRNA 6 (+7 public GSE140231); snATAC 5 (+2 public GSE147672)
processed_data_available: partial (raw on GEO; processed objects not verified)
main_conclusions_short: Cell type-resolved cRE atlas (128,724 cREs) of SN; cell type-specific dysregulated cREs in PD with strong transcriptional influence; 3D contact maps link 656 target genes incl. PD risk genes; modular cell-type expression of candidate genes
notes: VERIFIED counts from full text; not paired multiome (separate libraries); Korean/US ADRC donors

title: A single-nuclei paired multiomic analysis of the human midbrain reveals age- and Parkinson's disease-associated glial changes
main_conclusions_short: All glia affected by age, microglia and oligodendrocytes further altered in PD; disease-associated oligodendrocyte subtype, CARNS1 loss; chromatin accessibility changes little within cell types but peak-gene links substantially altered in aging/PD
notes: VERIFIED (PMC full text). medRxiv preprint 10.1101/2022.01.18.22269350

title: Single-nucleus multi-omics of Parkinson's disease reveals a glutamatergic neuronal subtype susceptible to gene dysregulation via alteration of transcriptional networks
accession: Synapse syn60245188, syn50996869; Duke Research Data Repository
data_access: controlled (Synapse, upon request); counts at Duke repository
main_conclusions_short: Glutamatergic excitatory neuron subtype with strongest PD dysregulation and SNCA overexpression; cis-regulatory accessibility changes, master TFs (YY1, SP3, KLF16) and PD-GWAS-linked regulatory variants underlie dysregulation
notes: VERIFIED (PMC full text)

title: RNA- and ATAC-sequencing reveals a unique CD83+ microglial population focally depleted in Parkinson's disease
regions: substantia nigra; VTA, substantia innominata, hypothalamus (PD donors only)
main_conclusions_short: 13 microglial subpopulations + PVM + monocytes; inflammatory microglia more prevalent in PD SN; CD83+/HIF1A+ microglia depleted in PD SN with unique chromatin signature; brainstem-specific in controls
notes: Preprint (Przedborski lab); no journal version found in PubMed as of 2026-10-21; data availability not located

title: Massive-scale single-nucleus multi-omics identifies novel rare noncoding drivers of Parkinson's disease
regions: 5 regions (likely substantia nigra, putamen, cingulate gyrus, middle temporal gyrus, cerebellum)
accession: IGVF Data Portal (snMultiome); CellxGene collection 16876983-d454-43db-a8ec-77fafca9bf38; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17173379; SRA PRJNA1418141 (Micro-C); GP2 WGS via AMP PD
main_conclusions_short: Cell type-specific PD features; cell type-specific caQTL/eQTL maps; ML models predict variant regulatory effects; rare noncoding variants associated with sporadic PD; candidate drivers of familial PD of unknown cause
notes: Corces lab (GP2/ASAP). Region list inferred from text (not explicitly listed); 642 multiome reactions

title: Modeling cis-regulatory variation in human brain enhancers across a large Parkinson's Disease cohort
modality: single-nucleus multiome (snATAC + snRNA) + long-read WGS + methylation QTL
accession: EGAS50000000921 (WGS); Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19034709 (+8 DOIs); SCope ASAP_brain; UCSC track hub; ASAP CRN Cloud release in prep
main_conclusions_short: 53,841 high-confidence cis enhancer variants (caQTL/meQTL/ASCA) in one or both regions; sequence-to-function models predict variant effects; most disrupt cell type-specific TF motifs; prioritized regulatory variants at PD GWAS loci incl. DA neurons
notes: Aerts lab (KU Leuven), Banner Sun Health donors. Per-region PD/ctrl split not stated (web snippet: cortex 75/115, SN 50/90 - unverified)

title: RNA Isoform Diversity in Human Neurodegenerative Diseases
modality: 10x snRNA-seq + targeted PacBio long-read single-nucleus isoform sequencing (50 genes)
n_other_disease: AD, DLB (25 donors total incl. PD and controls)
main_conclusions_short: Shared and distinct DE across AD/DLB/PD; vast isoform diversity in all 50 targeted disease genes, including genes not DE at gene level; method for novel isoform structure detection
notes: VERIFIED data statement; per-group n not extracted (25 donors total across AD/DLB/PD/ctrl)

title: Single cell transcriptomics reveals enrichment of aggregation-prone alpha-synuclein isoforms across synucleinopathies
main_conclusions_short: Many novel SNCA isoforms/exons; isoforms encoding alpha-Syn-115 proportionally increased in excitatory neurons of PD and DLB; especially in specific glutamatergic subtypes; in silico higher aggregation propensity
notes: PD count inconsistent in preprint (12 vs 13); same cohort/lab as shwab2024

title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals molecular dysfunction associated with cortical Lewy pathology
modality: NanoString GeoMx DSP Whole Transcriptome Atlas (neuron AOIs with vs without Lewy pathology); mouse CosMx
processed_data_available: yes (pre-QC data on Zenodo; source data)
main_conclusions_short: Specific excitatory neuron classes (L5 etc.) vulnerable to Lewy pathology; conserved LAMDA signature in aggregate-bearing neurons: down synaptic, mitochondrial, UPS, endolysosomal, cytoskeletal genes, up DNA repair and complement/cytokine genes; conserved in PFF mouse
notes: VERIFIED. 25 cases screened, 9 with abundant LB, 8 passed QC; no control donors; bioRxiv 10.1101/2023.05.17.541144; ASAP-funded

title: The spatial landscape of glial pathology and T cell response in Parkinson's disease substantia nigra
main_conclusions_short: CD8+ T cells enriched in PD SN with clonal expansion and TCRs homologous to alpha-syn-reactive; PD T cells spatially correlated with CD44+ astrocytes, which increase in PD SN; CD44 knockdown in astrocytes attenuates neuroinflammatory signatures
notes: VERIFIED (PMC full text). 44 donors overall; bioRxiv 10.1101/2024.01.08.574736

title: Unravelling cell type-specific responses to Parkinson's Disease at single cell resolution
main_conclusions_short: Neuron loss and increased glia/T cells in PD; depletion of TH-enriched astrocyte, microglia, oligodendrocyte and neuron subpopulations; spatial data confirmed cell types
notes: VERIFIED data statement; Mostly snRNA - overlaps snRNA track

title: Oligodendroglia vulnerability in the human dorsal striatum in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: 15 oligodendroglial subclasses, 4 PD-associated with heat-shock protein overexpression, immune/myelination alterations; disrupted OL differentiation trajectories; reduced myelin in PD striatum; spatial localization of disease-associated OLs
notes: OWN GROUP (Munoz-Manchado/Nilsson; Marco Salas co-author). Xenium donor subset n not extracted

title: Spatial multi-omics identifies early synaptic pruning and context-specific dopaminergic vulnerability in synucleinopathies
accession: SRA PRJNA1357890; PRIDE PXD062998; GitHub fstrueb/spatial_nigra
main_conclusions_short: alpha-syn seeding correlates with DA neuron loss in PD-spectrum but not AD-LBP; in iLBD before overt SN Lewy pathology, increased C1QC and loss of inhibitory synaptic markers; early complement-associated inhibitory synapse remodeling
notes: VERIFIED Visium counts (22 cases after QC; 4 excluded); Research Square preprint rs-7852229; ASAP acknowledged

title: Spatially resolved molecular signatures of Lewy body dementia
main_conclusions_short: Layer 5 GM most vulnerable with elevated SNCA, synaptic and metabolic dysregulation, exacerbated in APOE4; Reelin signaling disrupted across layers (validated in cohorts/organoids); WM myelination disruption, APOE4 more myelin debris/glial response
notes: VERIFIED counts; need Supplementary Table 1 to know if any PDD donors

title: Distinct spatial transcriptomic patterns of substantia nigra in Parkinson disease and Parkinsonian subtype of multiple system atrophy
main_conclusions_short: PD vs HC: 165 up / 350 down DEGs, down in ribosomal translation, mitochondria, UPS; MSA-P down immune/mitochondria/neural signaling vs PD; APP network hub in both
notes: VERIFIED. Very small n

title: Single-cell spatial transcriptomics reveals disease-specific microenvironmental niches in neurodegeneration and COVID-19
main_conclusions_short: Stressed neuron epicenters with metabolic/proteostasis gradients; metabolically stressed cells selectively in PD ACC vs DLB; SNCA/PINK1/PARK7 ~2x higher near stressed cells
notes: Keller lab (Saarland). Platform/donor counts from full-text fetch, not cross-checked

title: Single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomic analysis identified molecular features of neuronal heterogeneity and distinct glial responses in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: Two disease-associated trajectories each for astrocytes and microglia; early inflammatory microglial state; HSPA5 (microglia) and MSRB3/HDAC8 (astrocyte) regulatory modules; DA/glutamatergic neuron loss; progressive gliosis in DA nuclei
notes: Seoul National University Brain Bank; no journal version found

title: Disease and brain region specific immune response profiles in neurodegenerative diseases with pure and mixed protein pathologies
modality: IHC + NanoString nCounter + GeoMx DSP (protein/immune panels, ROI-level)
main_conclusions_short: Robust immune activation signature in AD retained in mixed AD+LB pathology; pure LBD shows attenuated, distinct immune signature; disease- and region-specific immune responses
notes: Borderline: ROI-level not single-cell; LBD donors may not be clinical PD; counts not extracted

title: Imaging mass cytometry reveals generalised deficiency in OXPHOS complexes in Parkinson's disease
modality: imaging mass cytometry (OXPHOS protein panel, single-neuron)
main_conclusions_short: Widespread decrease of all OXPHOS complexes in PD DA neurons (less severe than mito disease, different combinations); inter-individual heterogeneity; compensatory increase in mitochondrial mass
notes: Counts partly inferred from text

title: Astrocytic changes in mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation protein levels in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: Astrocytic OXPHOS subunit deficiencies and mitochondrial mass changes associated with PD, not simply age; inter-individual variability; astrocytes near vs far from neurons compared
notes: No PMC full text; counts/data not verified

title: Parkinson's disease neurons exhibit alterations in mitochondrial quality control proteins
main_conclusions_short: Generalised synergistic reduction of mitochondrial quality control proteins (pUb, LonP1, HTRA2, TFAM etc.) in PD DA neurons; changes associated with alpha-syn pathology at neuron level
notes: Counts partly inferred

title: PD5D Midbrain Visium 10x Spatial Transcriptomics (dataset; ASAP PD5D cohort)
accession: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22942068; ASAP CRN Cloud (Team Scherzer); Parkinson's Cell Atlas portal pd5d.yale.edu
main_conclusions_short: No publication yet
notes: Dataset-only entry (published 2026-09-23). PD5D also has snRNA/scATAC of MTG and SN and possibly MERFISH (portal lists Visium+MERFISH); track for future paper

title: Spatial RNA sequencing identifies robust markers of vulnerable and resistant human midbrain dopamine neurons and their expression in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: 33 stable SNc vs VTA DEGs; SNc markers SLIT1 and ATP2A3 down-regulated in PD
notes: BORDERLINE: pooled-cell LCM, not single-cell resolution; probably exclude

title: Single-cell epigenomic analyses implicate candidate causal variants at inherited risk loci for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases
regions: 7 regions incl. substantia nigra, putamen, cortex
main_conclusions_short: Brain scATAC atlas; ML classifier nominates functional PD/AD GWAS SNPs and target genes; MAPT inverted haplotype ectopic neuronal interactions
notes: EXCLUDE (no PD donors) - reference atlas only; its SN data reused by lee2023

title: The gene expression landscape of the human locus coeruleus revealed by single-nucleus and spatially-resolved transcriptomics
main_conclusions_short: LC-NE neuron molecular landscape
notes: EXCLUDE (no PD donors)
